duration: Conference at NC State, April 15 and 16, 2027
name: North Carolina Youth Institute
org: NC State Cooperative Extension with World Food Prize Foundation
what_you_do: Research a global food issue and write a 3 to 4 page paper with a teacher or mentor. Then present at a conference at NC State. Top students may represent North Carolina at the Global Youth Institute in Des Moines, Iowa.
who_can_apply: High school students in grades 9 to 12.
deadline_text: Next conference is April 15-16, 2027. Sign-up dates are not posted; the site says sign-up starts later in fall 2026. Last year's deadline was early March 2026.
how_to_apply: Register online when sign-up starts. Find the form on the NC Youth Institute site at NC State. You can get help from a mentor in a spring group.
notes: Sign-up date is not posted, as of Nov 3, 2026. Check ncyi.ncsu.edu. You need your own ride to Raleigh.
